name: aem-eds-ai-workflow-demo
description: Automated EDS Delivery: an agnostic delivery core (agentic-core) plus swappable provider/platform packs (eds, jira, github, figma, playwright) that sequence a work item from intake to a published change.

plugins.name: agentic-core
plugins.description: Agnostic delivery core: sequences stages, spawns pack adapters as subagents, reads the result envelope, and branches. Knows no tracker, SCM, design tool or browser by name.

plugins.name: eds
plugins.description: Platform pack for an Edge Delivery project: binds every stage of the default route to this platform's own conventions, calling the tracker, scm, design and browser provider packs where each stage needs them.

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Provider pack for the tracker role: fetch_item, post_note, attach_file, list_types against a real Jira Cloud site over its REST API.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Provider pack for the scm role: create_branch, publish_change, check_status against a real GitHub repository over the gh CLI.

plugins.name: figma
plugins.description: Provider pack for the design role: fetch_reference against a real Figma file, wrapping the Figma MCP server's design-context tools.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Provider pack for the browser role: render, capture, measure, interact against a real headless Chromium browser via the playwright npm library, run standalone with no MCP tool call.
